messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-7911 — service=\"inference-gateway\" severity=critical — symptom=5xx_error_rate_spike (links: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-7911)

pagerduty-bot: Trigger: error_rate > 8% over 3m for inference-gateway; routed to #incidents and @alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, joining now. Checking dashboards + traces.

bob: Looking at proxy logs — seeing a sudden surge of upstream 502s from eu-west1 origin nodes starting ~00:06 UTC, correlate with kvcache eviction time.

clara: Any deploys in the last 15m to gateway?

dino: No gateway deploys. There was a kvcache hotpatch rolled ~7m ago for prefix-ttl tuning (kvcache-service v2.3.1). It showed a warning in rollout logs about eviction storms.

ops-oncall: Taking lead from alice. Running quick query: `select count(*) from requests where status >=500 and region='eu-west1' and ts>now()-10m;` — returns 12k 5xx in last 10m, baseline ~120.

alice (oncall): OK, that's customer affecting. Runbook: inference-gateway -> 5xx-spike -> step 2 traffic-reroute & step 4 rollback-kvcache-config. Who can flip region weights? @sasha?

sasha: I can shift traffic. Preparing to shift 30% away from eu-west1 to us-west2 and eu-central. Will post weights in 30s.

bob: Also seeing elevated latency on backend model pool nodes; many requests retrying and thrashing kv client. Suggest disable kvcache inline config or revert to previous profile.

dino: Rolling back the kvcache patch now: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/kvcache-service --to-revision=3` — patch applied, watching pods restart.

pagerduty-bot: INC-7911 escalated to schedule: infra-sre (no ack within 5m)

ops-oncall: Traffic weights updated: eu-west1 => 50% -> 20%, eu-central -> 40%, us-west2 -> 40% (applied via infra-trafficctl). Observing error rate dropping in eu-west1 slice within 60s.

alice (oncall): After rollback + traffic shift, 5xx rate down from 9.3% -> 1.1% cluster-wide. Customer impact appears reduced. Continuing to monitor for 30m.

clara: Noted customer-facing impact: some inference API requests returned 502/504 for ~8m window, small percentage of sessions retried. Need to file follow-up with CS for affected tenants.

ops-oncall: Captured diagnostic bundle and logs: `s3://redwood-incident-bundles/INC-7911/2026-03-17/` — includes kvcache metrics, proxy traces, and deployment events.

alice (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Setting PD incident to \"acknowledged -> resolved\" after postmortem draft. :thumbsup:

dino: Follow-up action items: (1) revert agressive eviction defaults, (2) add canary for kvcache config, (3) tweak alert to include upstream-origin-spike tag. I'll create tickets.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. I'll open the postmortem draft and assign owners. Add any logs/notes to that doc.

incident-bot: INC-7911 status changed to RESOLVED by alice (oncall).

sasha: Quick note — customers in EU may see a few retried requests; we've queued a customer notice for CS to review.

alice (oncall): End of thread — last checkin at 00:16 UTC, monitoring window started. Will update if regression occurs.
